summary: FreeScout is a self-hosted Laravel/PHP helpdesk (ticket) application: agents reply to customer conversations, which are stored as Conversation + Thread records under Mailboxes and Folders, with Users, Customers (and their Email addresses), Attachments, Follower/Subscription relationships, SendLog dispatch records, Option settings, Modules, m2m mailbox_user pivot, and password_resets/notifications/jobs/log tables — a full relational CRUD surface over Eloquent + migrations.

_no_edges.why: public login route; authenticates, no call/requires/guards edge (LoginController.php:50)
signout action; no edge besides auth signout (routes/web.php:11)
public registration route; no edge besides the row insert (RegisterController.php:66)
public throttled route; sends reset link, no edge (ForgotPasswordController.php:50)
internal helper; sends invite + stamps invite_state, called from authorized createSave (app/User.php:702)
internal model helper; inserts Follower, no own wall (app/User.php:1295)
re-sends a thread's email; no wall beyond conversation view checked at send time (ConversationsController.php:2427)
marks current user's notifications read; no precondition (UsersController.php:560)
open web-cron route gated only by URL secret (env config), no DB preconditions; runs schedule:run (routes/open.php:19)

auth._evidence: Login controller verifies on User.email + User.password (LoginController.php:50); the auth effect names User as the account entity. FreeScout is single-inn (no tenant/company column), so $actor / $session.account_id := User.id and there is no session tenant field.
